episodes.synopsis: Gather your party and venture forth, Bell. The dungeon awaits.
episodes.title: Prelude | Night Before Departure

episodes.synopsis: Bell and his party are making good time and will soon enter the lower floors. But the dungeon crawl is going too smoothly, and Cassandra cannot shake her earlier premonition.
episodes.title: The Great Falls | The Great Falls

episodes.synopsis: The party has two options: either retreat to the surface with the injured or hunt the monster and hope its defeat will dispel the ailment. Both choices carry dire risks.
episodes.title: Parasite | Viscum Album

episodes.synopsis: The party learns too late that the Moss Huge can use other monsters against them. Meanwhile, Bell is alone, but not without allies; the Xenos have not forgotten his kindness.
episodes.title: Mermaid | The Girl of Water City

episodes.synopsis: Haruhime’s new ability turns the tide of battle, but the Moss Huge has proven that it knows what it’s doing. As the party strategist, Lili has a hard choice to make.
episodes.title: Argo Vesta | Heroic Slash of Holy Flame

episodes.synopsis: Bell’s exploits have earned him fame and a new alias, and Lili worries that means change is coming. Meanwhile, Ryu left a note for her coworkers and vanished soon afterwards.
episodes.title: Rabbit's Foot | Rabbit's Foot

episodes.synopsis: Ryu, the Gale Wind, stands accused of murder. Bell and his party need answers, but only Cassandra knows that tragedy will befall them if they pursue their friend.
episodes.title: Cassandra Ilion | Dream Seer

episodes.synopsis: Ryu couldn’t be the killer… right? Bell wants to help his friend, but as the body count grows higher, he must ask himself how well he truly knows her.
episodes.title: Mirabilis | Chaos

episodes.synopsis: While Bell and Ryu contend with Jura and his insidious abilities, the rest of Bell’s allies uncover a barrel of bad apples in the dungeon’s dark depths.
episodes.title: Lambton | Ill Omen

episodes.synopsis: Some monsters you must fight and from others you must flee. But beware the Juggernaut lest you simply cease to be.
episodes.title: Juggernaut | The Destroyer

episodes.synopsis: The Juggernaut slaughters its way through a dwindling number of survivors, forcing Ryu to face her demons.
episodes.title: Endless | Brutal
